title: RNA Extraction Using RNeasy Plant Mini Kit
author: Gonzalo Villarino
materials: Bring RNase-free gloves and sterile tools (scissors, tweezers).

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and prepare plant material for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Label 50 mL Falcon tubes for each cultivar.
Cut fresh flowers using sterile scissors, one sample at a time.
Weigh ~100 mg of the sample and place it into a labeled 50 mL Falcon tube with holes poked in the lid.
Flash-freeze the plant material immediately in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Grind Plant Material
steps.instruction: Pulverize the frozen tissue into a fine powder.

substeps.instruction: Grind the frozen material thoroughly with a mortar and pestle while keeping it in liquid nitrogen.
Transfer the finely powdered material to an RNase-free, pre-chilled 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Lyse Sample
steps.instruction: Perform chemical lysis of the plant material.

substeps.instruction: Add 450 µL Buffer RLT to the 2 mL tube containing the plant material.
Vortex vigorously for 1 minute until the sample is homogenous with no visible chunks or fibrous material.

steps.title: Clear Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove debris using a QIAshredder spin column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer all lysate (~450 µL) from the 2 mL tube to a lilac QIAshredder spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge for 2 min at full speed.

steps.title: Prepare for Column Loading
steps.instruction: Adjust the lysate for RNA binding.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (~400 µL) of the flow-through to a new RNase-free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the cell debris pellet.
Add ~200 µL (0.5 volume of 100% ethanol) to the cleared lysate.
Mix immediately by pipetting (DO NOT VORTEX). Do not centrifuge.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the RNeasy spin column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample (~600 µL), including any precipitate, to a pink RNeasy spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm).
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer RW1 to the column, centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the column, centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge for 2 min at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) to wash the membrane.

steps.title: Dry Spin Column
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and discard the old tube.
Close the lid and centrifuge at full speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Pre-warm RNase-free water to 37°C in a heat block.
Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube.
Add 30 µL of the RNase-free water directly to the spin column membrane.
Let it sit for 1 minute at room temperature.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 1 min at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) to elute the RNA.
